title: Outbox retry: lock-poison arms silently swallow failure with no log
description: outbox_tick() uses if let Ok(guard) = store.lock() in multiple places (contact lookup, message load). If the Mutex is poisoned (a prior handler panicked while holding it), these arms silently skip the entry and continue the loop. The top-level guard acquisition (line ~897) correctly returns on error, but inner acquisitions inside the per-entry loop do not. Result: on lock poison, delivery attempts silently stop with no log entry, operator sees no indication that the outbox is stuck, all Pending messages stay Pending forever. — Change inner if let Ok(guard) arms to either unwrap with a log statement or propagate to an early return from outbox_tick.
